hypotheses.binder: (hNS : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ N → q ∈ S)
hypotheses.justification: This follows from the other hypotheses. For a prime q dividing N, if q = p then p ∈ S follows from hpSmin and hSmin. If q ≠ p, hN.2 gives q ∈ Smin, hence q ∈ S by hSmin. The proof can derive this helper fact and use it in place of hNS wherever needed; no degenerate case is excluded.
